canonical_data: agent definitions, handoffs, session histories, and run traces
current_repo_note: JavaScript/TypeScript sibling of openai-agents-python (reviewed as openai-agents-sdk); provider coupling is left unreviewed beyond the documented provider-agnostic model-provider contract.
strengths: Small core loop of agents, handoffs, guardrails, and approvals covers multi-agent orchestration with tracing, sessions, and human-in-the-loop built in
Substitutable model-provider contract plus a Vercel AI SDK adapter keeps the runtime usable beyond OpenAI models
Sandbox agents, realtime voice agents, and MCP transports ship in one documented package with CI and hosted docs
weaknesses: OpenAI models and hosted execution paths remain the most complete and documented route
Deployment, persistence beyond sessions, permissions, and production hardening stay application-defined
Named non-OpenAI backends were not individually re-verified in this review
why_it_matters: Shows the provider-published SDK pattern in JavaScript: an open operational loop with replaceable model, session, and sandbox seams.
